caseNameFull: WEST Et Al. v. CARR Et Al.
attorneys: Harris A. Gilbert for appellants., George F. McCanless, Attorney General of Tennessee, and Thomas E. Fox, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
